title: rosa canina trachyphylla
intro: Rosa canina trachyphylla, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a shrub species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina trachyphylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina trachyphylla may also possess vasoprotective and anti-aging effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
